steps.send: ip link set eth0 up && udhcpc -i eth0 -n -q && printf 'https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/main\n' > /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache dosfstools e2fsprogs grub-efi sfdisk && ERASE_DISKS=/dev/vda setup-disk -m sys -s 0 /dev/vda

test -d /sys/firmware/efi && test -b /dev/vda && test -b /dev/vda2 && test -c /dev/hwrng && dd if=/dev/hwrng of=/tmp/dory-rng.bin bs=32 count=1 2>/dev/null && test "$(wc -c < /tmp/dory-rng.bin)" -eq 32 && test -c /dev/rtc0 && hwclock -r >/dev/null && ip link show eth0 >/dev/null && test "$(cat /sys/class/net/eth0/address)" = "5a:94:ef:e4:0c:ee" && printf 'DORY_%s\n' DEVICE_BASELINE_READY
